This hypothesis needs further investigation and the role of measurement bias on substantive conclusions remains to be established. METHOD The study sample comprised 10,405 community-dwelling older adults from six Latin American countries. We applied a Multiple Indicators Multiple Causes (MIMIC) model for a concurrent investigation of measurement bias and of the association between Euro-D symptom clusters and background variables.
